one_line: Mistral releases a cybersecurity model, policy actions rise, AI financing shifts, and LLM‑powered malware emerges.

themes.title: Mistral launches cybersecurity AI model
themes.text: Mistral AI released Large 4, a multimodal AI with 1 trillion parameters and 52 billion active parameters, intended to help organisations identify and fix cybersecurity vulnerabilities. The model can be downloaded and run independently.

stories.headline: Mistral AI releases Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter model for cybersecurity

themes.title: Policy moves shape AI data and infrastructure
themes.text: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology issued a handbook on the Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture to enable secure data sharing for AI training. In Arizona, state lawmakers and officials opposed new AI data center projects due to water depletion concerns.

stories.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training
Bipartisan opposition rises to AI data centers in drought‑stricken Arizona

themes.title: Funding rounds and valuations shift in AI
themes.text: Baseten announced a $2 billion funding round that could value it at up to $30 billion, following a previous $1.5 billion raise. OpenAI lowered its fundraising target to $20 billion while maintaining a $1.25 trillion valuation. CapGrid secured ₹50 cr in a pre‑Series B round, valuing it at ₹430 cr for expansion into drones and data centres. Intel shares fell 28% after a weak fourth‑quarter outlook, erasing about $12 billion from the U.S. government’s stake.

stories.headline: Baseten launches $2 billion funding round, valuation up to $30 billion
OpenAI cuts funding target to $20 billion, valuation stays at $1.25 trillion
CapGrid raises ₹50 cr funding, valued at ₹430 cr to expand into drones and data centres
Intel stock falls 28% after weak Q4 outlook, erasing $12B from US government stake

themes.title: Malware leverages LLMs for victim ranking
themes.text: The VOLTA‑AUTODOXER infostealer sends structured evidence bundles to large language models to assess and rank victims’ assets by value, using a fallback chain of three models if a model refuses the request.

stories.headline: Volta‑Autodoxer malware uses LLMs to rank victims by monetizable assets
